head_commit.message:
fix(core): enumerate the Ring discard offer on current master

Master #34 replaced the one-sample discard helper with enumerated legal sets.
The merge ref therefore kept the Ring call but lost fn sample_discard, failing
to compile, and the Ring offer was itself the same one-sample livelock shape.
Use hand_choice_offers(..., HandChoice::Discard) and assert one named offer per
card in hand with every offer validating.
